title: SensorReport
description: Uplink sensor sample from the ESP32. Sent every report_interval_ms from the hello, immediately on any PIR change but at most 5 per second, and after a query for sensors. The bridge splits it into sensor.environment and sensor.presence.

ts.description: Device time of the sample, ISO 8601 UTC, epoch based until the clock is synced.

temperature_c.description: Air temperature, degrees Celsius, one decimal place, null on sensor fault.

humidity_pct.description: Relative humidity, percent, integer 0 to 100, null on sensor fault.

lux.description: Ambient illuminance, lux, integer 0 to 100000, null on sensor fault.

ReportTrigger.title: ReportTrigger
ReportTrigger.description: interval is the periodic report, presence_change follows a PIR edge, query answers a query for sensors.

PresenceMap.title: PresenceMap
PresenceMap.description: PIR motion per zone, true while motion is detected. Only zones listed in hello.capabilities.presence_zones appear.
